text.title: North Star Metric Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from event data to an adopted NSM record: confirm eight weeks of usage and retention data, generate and score at least three value-event candidates, choose one and place every runner-up, write the computable definition with its dashboard, run the above-versus-below cohort validation, decompose the NSM into owned input metrics, name the gaming vectors and guards, then set change control and validate.

step.name: confirm-event-and-retention-data
step.input: The warehouse or analytics tool; per-account usage events; retention or paid-conversion by account.
step.action: Confirm at least 8 weeks of per-account usage events and retention (or paid conversion) are queryable. Record `product_name` and `decided_on`.
step.output: `product_name`, `decided_on`; a list of core value events available for counting.
step.decision-gate: No queryable event and retention data: skip per 06-decision-tree.xml; instrument the core events and return with cohorts.

step.name: generate-and-score-candidates
step.input: Candidate metrics proposed by product, marketing and sales; the five criteria.
step.action: List at least three candidates in `candidates[]`, each with `counts` (value_event, revenue, signups, registered_users, pageviews, sessions, mau) and `scores` 1 to 5 on customer_value, leading_indicator_of_revenue, actionable_within_quarter, understandable_without_data_team and measurable_today; set `total` to the sum.
step.decision-gate: Fewer than three candidates, or no candidate that counts a value event: regenerate before scoring (r-candidates-scored-against-criteria, r-nsm-counts-value-delivered).

step.name: choose-one-nsm-and-place-runner-ups
step.action: Set `chosen_nsm.name` to the highest-scoring value-event candidate (`is_highest_scoring: true`), or to another value-event candidate with `not_highest_because`. Put every other candidate in `runner_ups[]` as input_metric or rejected with a `rejection_reason`.
step.decision-gate: A revenue, signup, pageview, session or MAU candidate as the choice, or a second NSM of any kind: rejected (r-nsm-counts-value-delivered, r-single-nsm).

step.name: write-the-computable-definition
step.input: The event schema; the account model; internal and test account markers; the dashboard tool.
step.action: Fill `definition` in `templates/nsm-definition.md.j2` and the record: `events[]`, `unit`, `window` (daily, weekly, 28_day), `threshold`, `inclusions[]`, `exclusions[]` (internal accounts, test data, free vs paid rule), and publish the number at `dashboard_url`. Have a second analyst reproduce the current value from the definition alone.
step.decision-gate: Two analysts return different numbers: the definition is not computable; fix the wording before validation (r-nsm-definition-computable).

step.name: validate-against-retention
step.input: Accounts split by whether they cleared the threshold in the window; retention or paid conversion after the period.
step.action: Run the above-vs-below threshold cohort comparison on the product's own data and record `validation`: `cohort_size`, `period_start`, `period_end`, `outcome`, `rate_above`, `rate_below`, `delta`, `result` and `run_date`.
step.decision-gate: `result` no or inconclusive, or a delta that is not material: do not adopt; return to step 2 with a different candidate (r-nsm-validated-against-retention).

step.name: decompose-into-input-metrics
step.input: Team structure; current values of the candidate inputs.
step.action: Define three to five `input_metrics[]` along breadth, depth, frequency and efficiency, each with `owning_team`, `current_value`, `target` and `movable_within_quarter: true`; include every runner-up placed as input_metric under its own name.
step.decision-gate: An input nobody owns or nobody can move within a quarter is removed from the tree (r-input-metrics-tree).

step.name: name-gaming-vectors-and-guards
step.input: The definition; the teams whose bonuses or OKRs will attach to the NSM.
step.action: List in `gaming_risks.vectors[]` every way the NSM could rise without value (paid_signups, notification_spam, internal_or_bot_activity, threshold_lowering) with a `guard` (definition_exclusion, paired_quality_metric, paired_retention_metric, threshold_review_rule) and set `inflatable_by_spend_alone: false`.
step.decision-gate: An NSM one team can inflate with spend alone is rejected under r-nsm-counts-value-delivered (r-nsm-resists-gaming).

step.name: set-change-control-and-validate
step.input: Any previous NSM record; the review calendar.
step.action: Fill `change_control`: `previous_record` (null or its reference) with `series_break_date` when one exists, and `next_review_date` at most a year after `decided_on`. Write the record with `templates/north-star-metric.adr.md.j2` and run `scripts/validate-north-star-metric.py --file` on it.
step.decision-gate: A redefinition without a linked previous record and a series-break date is a silent change and is not published (r-nsm-change-is-a-new-record).

list.item: Record validates via `scripts/validate-north-star-metric.py` with no violation, including score sums, the highest-candidate rule, the retention delta and runner-up coverage.
The current NSM value is published at `definition.dashboard_url` and reproducible by a second analyst.
Every input metric has a named owning team that has accepted its target.
